dimensions.assessment: Affects subset participants in Social Security Disability Insurance demonstration projects and the Social Security Administration.
dimensions.evidence: carry out demonstration projects within the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) program.

dimensions.assessment: Tests temporary policy changes on participants while legally protecting total individual income from reduction due to participation.
dimensions.evidence: that the total income of an individual will not be reduced due to the individual's participation in an experiment or demonstration project.

dimensions.assessment: Administrative expenses paid from administrative funds; benefits paid from Social Security Trust Funds as determined by the Commissioner.
dimensions.evidence: Administrative expenditures for experiments and demonstration projects under section 234 shall be paid from funds made available for the administration of this title.

dimensions.assessment: Amends title II of the Social Security Act to extend demonstration authority, adjust notice periods to 120 days, and require evaluation metrics.
dimensions.evidence: The Act may be cited as the Removing Barriers to Work for Disabled Americans Act
the authority to carry out such projects shall terminate on December 31, 2031

missing_information: The exact number of demonstration projects or participants that will be selected.
importance_detail.rationale: Temporarily reauthorizes Social Security Disability Insurance demonstration project authority through 2031, adds total income protections, and modifies notification timelines.
